ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム００８３ ＳＴＡＲＤＵＳＴ ＭＥＭＯＲＹ 宇宙の蜉蝣２』から、肩部スラスターが特徴的なドラッツェ改が登場！
機動戦士ガンダム００８３ Ｂｌｕ-ｒａｙ ｂｏｘ（発売元：バンダイビジュアル株式会社）に収録の映像特典 新作エピソード
『宇宙の蜉蝣２』に登場する、ドラッツェ改をＨＧＵＣシリーズで商品化。
劇中イメージの成形色カラーを採用し、特徴的な本体形状と武装を再現！！
●　噴射ノズルが露出した形状の肩部スラスターを新規型で再現！！
肩が球形のスラスター・ポッドから、宇宙突撃艇のスラスターを流用したタイプに変更された形状を
ディテール豊かに再現。
●　劇中で使用するザク・マシンガンが付属！
●　劇中のイメージを踏襲した成形色に変更！
●　専用スタンド付属
ジョイントパーツは、アクションベース２（別売）にも対応。

en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 STARDUST MEMORY Space Lizard 2" comes the Draze Kai with its distinctive shoulder thrusters!
Video bonus new episode included in Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 Blu-ray box (Release source: Bandai Visual Co., Ltd.)
The Doratze Kai that appears in "Space Lizard 2" has been commercialized in the HGUC series.
Adopting the molding color of the image in the play, the characteristic body shape and weapons are reproduced! !
● Reproduce the shoulder thruster with an exposed injection nozzle in a new model! !
The shape has been changed from a thruster pod with spherical shoulders to a type that borrows the thruster of a space assault boat.
Reproduced with rich detail.
● Zaku machine gun used in the movie is included!
● The molding color has been changed to follow the image in the play!
● Dedicated stand included
Joint parts are also compatible with Action Base 2 (sold separately).
Attached weapons: Zaku Machine Gun / Gatling Gun / Triple 40mm Vulcan Cannon / Beam Saber / Seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
